## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

vistypes <- c(
  "adjacent", "animation", "bivariate_corner", "bivariate_range",
  "triple_CI", "uncert_markers",  "basic"
)
```

```{r}
correct1 <- read_excel("correct.xlsx", sheet = 1)
answers1 <- setNames(correct1$`Solution ID`, correct1$Variable)
correct1$Vistype
```

```{r}
data = fread("data_uncertain_topoplots_pilot1.csv") %>% filter(`STATUS` == "complete")
```


```{r}
# ---------- Task 1 ----------
task1 <- data[, A101:A121]
task1_correct <- sweep(
  as.matrix(task1),
  2,
  answers1[colnames(task1)],
  FUN = "=="
)

task1_scores <- data.frame(
  vistype = unname(vistypes),

  task1_mean = unname(sapply(vistypes, function(v) {
    cols <- correct1$Variable[correct1$Vistype == v]
    mean(task1_correct[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  })),

  task1_rowsum = unname(sapply(vistypes, function(v) {
    cols <- correct1$Variable[correct1$Vistype == v]
    mean(rowSums(task1_correct[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
  }))
)
task1_scores
```

```{r}
# ---------- Task 2 ----------
task2 <- data[, A204_01:A204_07]

task2_scores <- data.frame(
  vistype = vistypes,

  task2_mean_raw = as.numeric(colMeans(task2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  task2_mean_norm = unname(as.numeric(colMeans(task2, na.rm = TRUE))) / 8,

  task2_rowsum = as.numeric(colSums(task2, na.rm = TRUE))
)
task2_scores
```
```{r}
# ---------- Task 3 ----------
eval1 <- data[, A301_01:A301_07]
eval2 <- data[, A302_01:A302_07]
eval3 <- data[, A303_01:A303_07]
eval4 <- data[, A304_01:A304_07]

# temporary
eval_order <- c(
  "adjacent", "bivariate_corner", "bivariate_range",
  "triple_CI", "uncert_markers", "animation", "basic"
)

eval_mean_by_vistype <- function(eval_data, eval_order, score_name) {
  out <- data.frame(
    vistype = eval_order,
    mean = as.numeric(colMeans(eval_data, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

  names(out)[2] <- score_name
  out
}

eval1_scores <- eval_mean_by_vistype(eval1, eval_order, "comparison_mean")
eval2_scores <- eval_mean_by_vistype(eval2, eval_order, "detection_mean")
eval3_scores <- eval_mean_by_vistype(eval3, eval_order, "usage_mean")
eval4_scores <- eval_mean_by_vistype(eval4, eval_order, "appealing_mean")

eval_scores <- eval1_scores %>%
  left_join(eval2_scores, by = "vistype") %>%
  left_join(eval3_scores, by = "vistype") %>%
  left_join(eval4_scores, by = "vistype")

eval_scores
```

```{r}
time_detection <-  data[, TIME008:TIME028]

time_key <- data.frame(
  time_col = colnames(time_detection),
  inputId = sprintf("A201_%02d", 1:21),
  vistype = c(
    "adjacent", "animation", "bivariate_corner", "bivariate_range", "triple_CI", "uncert_markers", "basic",
    "adjacent", "animation", "bivariate_corner", "bivariate_range", "triple_CI", "uncert_markers", "basic",
    "adjacent", "animation", "bivariate_corner", "bivariate_range", "triple_CI", "uncert_markers", "basic"
  )
)

time_scores <- data.frame(
  vistype = vistypes,

  time_mean = sapply(vistypes, function(v) {
    cols <- time_key$time_col[time_key$vistype == v]
    mean(as.matrix(time_detection[, ..cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
  }),

  time_sum = sapply(vistypes, function(v) {
    cols <- time_key$time_col[time_key$vistype == v]
    sum(as.matrix(time_detection[, ..cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
  }),

  row.names = NULL
)

time_scores
```


```{r}
# ---------- Combine ----------
vistype_scores <- left_join(
  task1_scores,
  task2_scores,
  by = "vistype"
) %>% left_join(
  .,
  time_scores,
  by = "vistype"
)

vistype_scores
```
